feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 30 June 2026 9:59pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 30 June 2026 at 10:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Ridge of high pressure is displaced from the west by a deepening area of low pressure and associated frontal zone.


##Wind##

West or southwest 2 to 4, quickly veering northwest 3 or 4 occasionally 5, backing west or southwest 2 to 4 tomorrow morning, backing south or southwest 5 to 7 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming mainly moderate later.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, then occasional rain or drizzle later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or drizzle.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southwest 6 or 7, veering west or southwest 5 or 6 early Thursday morning, veering west or northwest 3 to 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough becoming slight or moderate later.


##Weather##

Occasional rain or drizzle, soon becoming fair.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or drizzle.
